handoff.summary: Creatures bigger and one size (display only, physics/times/leaderboard unchanged, no RULES bump): race scale lets the tallest pose reach SPILL=0.4 of a lane into the lane behind (~1.4x), and a drawing spanning <150 pad px is drawn proportionally smaller (looks() in src/render.ts, floor 0.35), on the race sheet and the draw preview. layout.spec allows a front creature to overlap the one behind only by reaching up within SPILL. Results thumbnail now fits its 96 px frame on compact screens. Screens use clean paper inside the frame; the grid shows only in the desktop margin. README rewritten (visual, features, trmi collaboration; images in docs/). Deployed to Workers and Pages. Live on Workers (https://squiggle-cup.ksmostofa576.workers.dev/) and classic Cloudflare Pages (https://squigglecup.pages.dev/); both share the relay and the leaderboard, and both pass the three-client room test. Scoring is strict (rules r3): craft = cohesion x line quality (steady strokes, closed loops) x (expression + detail over ten feature kinds), form tolerances tight; beginners median 0.48, the best house creature about 0.63, the shared 14.60 s ceiling needs an expert drawing. House skills [-0.4, -0.2, 0, 0.2]: an ordinary drawing places 2.8 of 5 and wins 10%. Added: 1v1 challenge of any leaderboard creature (repeat rematch/redraw), My creatures (every raced drawing kept on the device, reusable), pause/exit (Esc or II; solo pauses, rooms offer leave), every part of a drawing collides with the floor (no sinking; regression test), tilt-shift look (tilt 0.3, blurred margins), names beside creatures so creatures use the whole lane. Creatures stay plain ink: a 3D extrusion was tried and removed at the user's request. Latest round: animated home (the logo's squiggle draws itself and its creature scurries along it; a live strip runs a house creature by the real engine), a compact layout with every screen's main buttons in view without scrolling at 1280x800, 390x844 and 375x667 (test/browser/fold.spec.ts), no browser menu on long press or right click except in text fields, OG image and an 8 s silent H.264 loop (public/og.png, public/og.mp4, scripts/og.mjs) wired into og:video, creatures a little bigger (dangling and paddling feet no longer dip below the floor, a smaller drawn wingbeat, every non-leg part collides with the floor), and test/browser/audit.spec.ts covering lineup behaviour, one scale for the whole race, leaderboard, 1v1, My creatures and pause. Demo script: https://claude.ai/artifact/UDx3A7d7YPKNLKGjVXA3Gc
next: Demo video: script at https://claude.ai/artifact/UDx3A7d7YPKNLKGjVXA3Gc, rewritten 2026-11-02: Apple-launch style, short beat-synced voiceover (runs, flies, slithers; never "trots"), punchy ~120 BPM music that drops to half-time slow motion in the last 3 s before the finish line.
